name: Archive a dataset
description: Archive a dataset Archive a dataset. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/datasets/{id}/archive/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/datasets/{id}/archive/
Archive a dataset. Archived datasets remain readable and reject item mutations.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this dataset.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
